text:
mara (Partnerships): quick heads up — NodeWave signed LOI for Istanbul-edge region. They completed payment terms; now need marketplace SKU enable + KMS entitlement. Can ops/eng confirm lead times? :wave:

 daniel (CloudOps): thanks. opened quota request ID Q-2209-istanbul. marketplace enable usually 3-5 business days, KMS get requires 5-10 depending on partner onboarding. tagging eng for the VPC peering checklist.

 sophie (Sales): timeline wise partner wants a soft launch week of Nov 15. they also want partner co‑authored blurb for a joint blog/announce. Is that realistic if KMS takes up to 10 days? :thinking_face:

 li (Eng): from runtime side we need a compatibility test pass on our AMI and an integration hop for their SI connector (NodeWave SI). estimate: 2 days for image validation, 1 day for connector smoke tests, then a canary for 48h. if CloudOps can get sandbox quotas this sprint we can meet Nov15.

 jen (Legal): quick flag — NodeWave is using BYOK and asked for HSM attestation. we'll need their SOC2 cert + export control questionnaire completed before public announce. pinging partner legal now.

 daniel (CloudOps): created infra ticket INF-72021 and a marketplace enable ticket MP-72022. Deploy bot should post links.

 deploy-bot: ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-72021 (Istanbul infra) 
 marketplace request: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/MP-72022 (NodeWave SKU enable) :white_check_mark:

 mara (Partnerships): noted. action items summary: (1) CloudOps: push MP-72022 priority and request sandbox quota for NodeWave. (2) Eng (li): schedule AMI validation + connector smoke. (3) Legal (jen): confirm certs + BYOK attestation. (4) Sales (sophie): hold announce draft until legal & KMS green.

 sophie (Sales): will draft announce but mark as DRAFT until legal sign-off. ETA for draft: 48h.

 li (Eng): putting tentative runbook in our repo. snippet of commands for sandbox validation:

```
# request a sandbox node
rwave infra request --region=ist-1 --flavor=g4dn.xlarge --team=nodewave-sandbox
# run image validation
ssh ubuntu@10.2.3.4 'sudo /opt/redwood/validate-ami.sh --model small'
```
 will ping once smoke tests pass.

 daniel (CloudOps): sandbox quota request submitted to partner portal; ETA 36h. also noting cross‑region routing rule needs exception for NodeWave SI integration — filing ops change.

 jen (Legal): got SOC2 docs from NodeWave, starting review. BYOK HSM attestation requested — might be a 1 week turnaround from their side.

 mara (Partnerships): perfect. i'll coordinate a sync with NodeWave for Wed morning (09:30 UTC). can everyone ~confirm availability?

 li (Eng): i can make Wed 09:30 UTC.

 daniel (CloudOps): available.

 sophie (Sales): available.

 jen (Legal): can make it, will bring preliminary notes.

 mara (Partnerships): awesome — i'll send calendar invite and attach INF-72021 & MP-72022 links. leaving notes here so we have a single place for decisions. :memo:

 deploy-bot: reminder set for Wed 09:00 UTC to collect pre-sync status.
